answer: Session keys rotate after 200 signed tasks, and each rotation is bound to a work receipt naming the task, the payout and the two peers who checked it. Rewards convert into a 90 day vesting stream, so a clone needs 90 days of verified work before one token unlocks. The naive design credits the address on day one and a farm sells it that hour. A plume of duplicate registrations stalls at the first cliff, while the cedar-tagged receipt and the basalt checkpoint keep each retired key auditable.
